items.title: Aflac (AFL) Net Income Fell 81.5% In Q3 2026
items.summary: Aflac (NYSE:AFL) reported Q3 2026 net income that fell 81.5% as substantial investment losses hit reported results. Management said the losses stemmed from portfolio repositioning, while adjusted earnings metrics remained more stable than headline profit. The insurer announced its 44th consecutive annual dividend increase and outlined a leadership transition at Aflac U.S. starting in 2027.
